subject: maths
question: Pipes A and B can fill an empty cistern in 72 minutes and 76 minutes, respectively. Both Pipe A and Pipe B are opened together. After how much time should Pipe B be turned off so that the empty cistern is completely filled in a total of 54 minutes?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A fills the cistern in = 72 minutes

Pipe B fills the cistern in = 76 minutes

Both pipes are opened together.

Total time to fill the cistern = 54 minutes

**Formula used:**

Total Capacity (Work) = LCM of individual times

Efficiency = Total Capacity / Time taken

Work done = Efficiency × Time

Remaining Work = Total Capacity - Work done

**Calculations:**

Let the total capacity of the cistern be the LCM of 72 and 76.

Prime factorization of 72 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 = 23 × 32

Prime factorization of 76 = 2 × 2 × 19 = 22 × 191

LCM(72, 76) = 23 × 32 × 191 = 8 × 9 × 19 = 72 × 19 = 1368 units

So, Total Capacity = 1368 units.

Efficiency of Pipe A = 1368 units / 72 minutes = 19 units/minute

⇒ Efficiency of Pipe B = 1368 units / 76 minutes = 18 units/minute

Pipe A works for the entire duration of 54 minutes.

Work done by Pipe A in 54 minutes = Efficiency of A × Time A worked

⇒ Work done by A = 19 units/minute × 54 minutes = 1026 units

⇒ Work done by B = 1368 - 1026 = 342 units

Time for which Pipe B worked = Work done by B / Efficiency of B

⇒ Time for which Pipe B worked = 342 units / 18 units/minute

⇒ Time for which Pipe B worked = 19 minutes

Pipe B should be turned off after this much time.

**∴ Pipe B should be turned off after 19 minutes.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

**Given:**

Pipe A = 72 min, Pipe B = 76 min, Total = 54 min

**Formula used:**

Work = rate × time

Calculation:

A alone for 54 min does = dfrac{54}{72}=dfrac{3}{4}

Remaining work = 1 - 3/4 = 1/4

Extra rate when B is also open = Rate(B) = dfrac{1}{76}

Need x min of both so that x × Rate(B) = 1/4

⇒ xtimesdfrac{1}{76}=dfrac{1}{4}

⇒ x=dfrac{1}{4}×76=dfrac{76}{4}=19

**∴ Turn off Pipe B after 19 minutes.**
